description: This source file defines an enumeration `EventKitAuthorization` with static methods to determine read/write permissions based on `EKAuthorizationStatus`. It encapsulates authorization logic related to the EventKit framework, specifically handling different authorization statuses.

methods.name: allowsRead
methods.description: Returns true if the given authorization status permits read access; otherwise false.

methods.name: allowsWrite
methods.description: Returns true if the given authorization status permits write access; otherwise false.
